content.value: What is the difference between the System Conversion and New Implementation transition paths to SAP S/4HANA? (Choose two.)
A. Custom code is developed in System Conversion and adjusted in New Implementation of SAP S/4HANA in the Realize phase.
B. Data is migrated in System Conversion and converted in New Implementation of SAP S/4HANA in the Realize phase.
C. Custom code is adjusted in System Conversion and developed in New Implementation of SAP S/4HANA in the Realize phase.
D. Data is converted in System Conversion and migrated in New Implementation of SAP S/4HANA in the Realize phase.
